<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule. The most direct way is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample and count the signals that fall in the typical aromatic region (≈120–150 ppm). This requires using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool once, then analyzing the returned spectrum to count peaks in that range.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
